externalCandidates.adoptionDecision: The project proves that principal units are n-th powers when the residue characteristic does not divide n. The Dubon cyclotomic stage has p-power degree, so that coprime-exponent Hensel result does not discharge the needed norm comparison. The pinned small-ball power theorem is both applicable and shorter.

localReuse.reason: Normality identifies the chosen finite Galois image stages. Density of rational numbers in the rational p-adic completion, the small-ball power bijection, and the norm of scalar embeddings then turn every order-zero residual rational unit into the norm-equivalent image of a positive coprime natural quotient. This is the shortest pinned route and avoids an upgrade or a new principal-unit hierarchy.

obligationEffect.serves: DUB-17 local reciprocity chain: arbitrary rational-unit reciprocity action -> cyclotomic principal product -> arithmetic invariant sum-zero -> global duality.
obligationEffect.discharged: For every q : ℚˣ, the proof splits off its p-power, proves that the remaining order-zero unit has norm one, compares it through an actual finite-stage norm with a positive p-coprime quotient, transports the norm witness between the selected cyclotomic stages, kills both the norm-kernel and prime-power terms, and invokes the proved positive-quotient root action. The sign is absorbed by positive p-adic approximation; no trivial action of -1 is assumed. The modular inverse data now also prove that composing the ramified action with the constructed quotient's forward exponent fixes the actual primitive root.
obligationEffect.stillOpen: Identify the forward positive-quotient exponent with the existing normalized away-prime product and the actual real-sign action. Then conclude the cyclotomic principal product and prove arithmetic invariant sum-zero.
obligationEffect.gateImpact: A necessary local DUB-17 sub-obligation is closed, but DUB-17 through DUB-20 remain open and source acceptance remains 16/20.
